scripts.build: npm run build -w @codeprint/core && npm run build -w @codeprint/print && npm run build -w @codeprint/cli && npm run build -w @codeprint/mcp && npm run build -w @codeprint/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @codeprint/core && npm run dev -w @codeprint/web
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:run && npm run build && npm run mcp:smoke && npm pack --dry-run --cache .npm-cache -w @codeprint/core && npm pack --dry-run --cache .npm-cache -w @codeprint/print && npm pack --dry-run --cache .npm-cache -w @codeprint/cli && npm pack --dry-run --cache .npm-cache -w @codeprint/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @codeprint/core && npm run build -w @codeprint/print && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
